lines.text: 8:58am, corridor B. Finn the fish slipper is almost late. the floor is freshly mopped.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: late late late late—

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: WHOOOOA—

lines.speaker: crush
lines.text: OOF!

lines.speaker: crush
lines.text: ...watch where you're sliding.
Clover the bunny slipper hops away. Finn stays on the floor for a while, is this love at first sight??

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: ok. one apology text. ummm... i'm sweating

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: BRO just slide into her DMs. What's the worst that can happen?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: she's ALREADY typing?!

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: she didn't block you. that's a WIN.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: she's typing again. oh no. oh no no no.
**buzz. buzz. buzz.**

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: right... i may have told the groupchat. only a little.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: my phone won't STOP buzzing!!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: ummmm it's okay!! i can swipe them away. click them, or press Q. i can multitask.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: i slipped on a TEXT. how do you even do that.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: breathe. type it again. slower.

lines.speaker: crush
lines.text: ok you're weirder than i expected.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: oh umm is that like, a good thing?

lines.speaker: crush
lines.text: hmm... still deciding.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: that conversation was a slip 'n slide.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: she's typing. not typing. typing. NOT typing.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: again! small talk is just talk. you can do this!!

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: she's TEASING you. teasing is basically flirting!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: or i dunno... making fun of me.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: ...it's the same thing!!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: i can't believe i sent that. i just can't.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: you can. you did. now send something better.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: she's going to the dance?! to THE dance?!

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: ASK. HER. NOW.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: i'm sweating so much. is that normal.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: ok. that was a complete disaster.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: why did i send that omggg why did i send that.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: again. againn.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: ...bro.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: last try. don't slip.
the next morning. corridor B. the floor is freshly mopped. again.

lines.speaker: crush
lines.text: walk with me to class? try not to slip this time.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: ...no promises.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: I TOLD YOU. SLIDE. INTO. HER. DMS.
they walked to class together. Finn only slipped twice. a personal record.

lines.speaker: crush
lines.text: you're funny, Finn. let's be friends?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: friends. umm. great. love that for us.

lines.speaker: crush
lines.text: also i'm taking the other corridor. just so you know.
Finn gained a friend and lost nothing but a little dignity. it was already on the floor.

lines.speaker: crush
lines.text: that was the weirdest, funniest chat of my life. walk me to class?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: YES. watch this smooth exit.
Finn spins dramatically. the floor is freshly mopped. again.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: WHOOOOA—

lines.speaker: crush
lines.text: FINN!!
crash number two. Clover was laughing too hard to help. true love needs traction.
